The painted view is the Craigieburn trail-guide photo laid onto the terrain (its lines and labels removed), with a matching painting where the photo can't see; the satellite view is a Sentinel-2 scene from 31 Jul 2026. Runs, names and grades are traced from the trail guide and laid onto the terrain, so every run line is an estimate; lifts and buildings are from OpenStreetMap.
